scope: Read-only BLE diagnostic session on one Allmiibo LCD after the application update.
limits: The timing starts at application storage initialization and ends at first dispatch. Bootloader, early SDK startup and the first visible LCD output fall outside this interval.
One recorded start per firmware on the same device does not establish a typical speedup.
The observed stack watermark covers execution since marking began at application entry. The BLE read did not exercise worst-case stack or heap use.

This BLE client read firmware version, boot diagnostics and runtime markers. The complete application image, browser interface, collection contents, physical button operation and NFC were outside this session.
